title: Three decks of the ark and spirit, soul and body (1 Thessalonians 5:23)
summary: Genesis 6:16 with its last line emphasised and changed to read 'lower, 2nd, and 3rd decks', above the three words Spirit, Soul, Body and 1 Thessalonians 5:23, a blessing that the whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless.

text.text: 16 “You shall make a window for the ark, and finish it to a cubit from the top; and set the door of the ark in the side of it; you shall make it with lower, 2nd, and 3rd decks.
23 May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

numbers.note: three decks of the ark; spirit, soul and body
